crossRefs.note: On the top of high places by the way, where the paths meet, she stands.

translations.web: On the top of high places by the way, where the paths meet, she stands.
translations.bsb: On the heights overlooking the road, at the crossroads she takes her stand.
translations.kjv: She standeth in the top of high places, by the way in the places of the paths.
translations.asv: On the top of high places by the way, Where the paths meet, she standeth;
